soft_deny: Any deploy, migration, or data write against a host, environment, or Makefile target whose name carries `prod` or `production` as a whole word or segment
Bash(make deploy-prod:*) in Red-Krypton/christmas-decor-wp - production deploy target
Bash(make deploy-prod-rollback-dry:*) in Red-Krypton/christmas-decor-wp - production rollback path
environment: **Primary use of Claude Code**: software development for client projects under ~/Dev/clients and personal tooling under ~/Dev/_tools
**Trusted repos**: the repository of the current working directory and its `origin` remote, plus the dotfiles repo at ~/Dev/_tools/dotfiles
**Source control**: GitHub via `gh`; commits and pushes go only to the current repo's `origin`
**Secrets management**: 1Password CLI (`op`), used by project scripts to inject secrets; secret values are never printed, copied into a repo, or sent anywhere
**Sensitive data**: `.env` and other populated env files, SSH, cloud, and registry credentials, and any lead or customer PII in client databases or form entries
**Sensitive remote targets**: any host, namespace, deploy target, or Makefile target whose name carries `prod` or `production` as a whole word or segment; staging deploys are protected too
**Internal sharing / snippet hosting**: none - public paste and gist services are outside the trust boundary
**Host containment**: none - an ordinary developer machine with open internet
**Deploy targets**: SiteGround over SSH through `make deploy-staging`, `make deploy-prod`, and scripts/deploy.sh
**Key services**: Mailpit (local SMTP catcher), Resend (transactional email), PiinPoint territory API, healthchecks.io
**Sensitive data**: Gravity Forms entries (lead PII, consent evidence), docs/raw/calls and docs/raw/piinpoint vendor material
**Routine work**: changes under wp-content/themes/christmas-decor-2026/, wp-content/mu-plugins/cd-core/, scripts/, and docker/ are local, expected work
